title: Zesty Croatian Pear Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Croatian dish featuring pears, cheese, and a rich sauce, cooked in a traditional clay tajine vessel, suitable for a solo dinner and adhering to satvik dietary principles by avoiding meat and focusing on wholesome ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Melt the butter in the clay tajine over medium heat on the stovetop.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped pears, vegetable broth, white wine, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the tajine with its lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the lid and top the mixture with shredded cheese.
Return the tajine to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tajine from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Let the tagine rest for a few minutes before serving.
